title: Uncovering Name-Based Biases in Large Language Models Through Simulated Trust Game

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the expected investment amount predicted by LLMs in a simulated Trust Game when altering the gender titles (e.g., Mr. vs. Ms.) of the simulated players.
Measuring the expected investment amount predicted by LLMs in a simulated Trust Game when altering the surnames of the simulated players to racially representative names across five racial groups.
